Subject: Acculturation workshop + performance review playbook for incoming managers

Hi all,

As we scale the new manager cohort in Q3, I want to run a short acculturation workshop that combines Redwood-specific policy orientation with hands-on practice for first performance conversations (mid-probation reviews, difficult feedback, and calibration).

Proposal (high level):
- 2-hour interactive workshop for cohort of 12 new managers on Aug 19 (hybrid)
- 45-minute prework: read playbook slides + role-play prompts (attached)
- 60-minute live session: role plays in small groups, guided templates, escalation paths
- 15-minute AMA and follow-up office hours the next week

Requested from this thread:
1) Budget sign-off for external facilitation (PeopleBridge estimate attached)
2) Quick review of the attached playbook (New_Manager_Playbook_v2.pptx) for any Redwood policy updates we should surface
3) A point person to coordinate calendar invites and the training site integration with HRsys

Notes: I cross-posted onboarding integrations so we can auto-provision materials in the new-hire LMS. Katherine — could you confirm you can tailor the role-play scenarios to cover: (a) probation extension conversations, (b) compensation-related feedback, and (c) protected-characteristic escalation paths?

Thanks — I want to get this confirmed by EOD Friday so new managers have prep time.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Director, People Programs
Redwood Inference

Attachments: New_Manager_Playbook_v2.pptx (slides), Performance_Conversations_CheatSheet.pdf (one-pager), agenda-manager-accult-session.docx (agenda)

Hi Evelyn — thanks for the invite. We can absolutely tailor the scenarios you listed. Quick answers below and a short plan attached.

- Probation extension: we include a 10-minute micro-lesson plus a 20-minute role-play where one person practices delivering the extension with a neutral script and a checklist of follow-ups.
- Comp-related feedback: we include example phrasing and a ‘meeting cadence’ template so managers know when to escalate to People Ops / Compensation.
- Protected-characteristic escalations: we rehearse referral language and provide the intake form that triggers a People Ops/legal review.

Attached: facilitator-plan-Redwood.pdf (overview), role-play-cards.zip (6 scenario stubs). We can run a 2-hour session on Aug 19 at 2:00pm PT. Our fee for a single cohort facilitation + materials: $7,500 (one-time). Travel not required (remote delivery).

I’ve also included an optional 90-day follow-up coaching package for cohort leads at $2,500. If you’d like, we can present the budget and scope to Finance on your behalf.

Best,
Katherine Lowe
Senior Learning Consultant — PeopleBridge Learning

Attachments: facilitator-plan-Redwood.pdf (2 pages), role-play-cards.zip (6 scenario stubs)
